meta.scope: Thailand Batch 4 — Bangkok / provincial structure, electricity generation, and banking system densification.

candidates.title: Bangkok Gross Regional / Provincial Product
candidates.publisher: Office of the National Economic and Social Development Council (NESDC)
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Bangkok — the dominant primate-city economy, accounting for a very large share of national GDP through services, finance, trade, tourism and headquarters activity.
candidates.notes: Primary primate-city economic node. Highest single provincial share.

candidates.title: Provincial and regional product structure framing
candidates.publisher: Derived from NESDC Gross Regional and Provincial Product series
candidates.description: System-level view of the strong concentration of economic activity in Bangkok and the Central / Eastern seaboard (including EEC provinces), with secondary poles and lagging regions elsewhere. Continuously cited in spatial and development analysis.
candidates.notes: Spatial densification frame linking Bangkok, EEC and the rest of the country.

candidates.title: Electricity generation and capacity statistics
candidates.publisher: Energy Policy and Planning Office / EGAT related
candidates.description: Installed generation capacity, power generation by fuel type, peak demand and consumption statistics. Natural gas, coal, hydro, renewables and imports form the mix; power is a critical infrastructure series for industry and tourism.

candidates.title: Banking system structure and credit statistics
candidates.description: Statistics on the structure of the banking system, total assets, credit aggregates and related indicators. The system is assessed as resilient with solid capital and liquidity buffers.

candidates.title: Non-performing loans and banking asset-quality statistics
candidates.description: System-wide NPL (Stage 3) ratios and volumes. Recent readings place the NPL ratio in the high-2% range; asset quality is closely monitored under SME and consumer credit pressures.
candidates.notes: Core asset-quality / risk node for the banking cluster.

candidates.title: Thailand Bangkok–power–banking densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from NESDC, energy and BOT sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Bangkok GRDP, provincial/regional structure framing, electricity generation statistics, banking system structure and NPL statistics into a coherent spatial–energy–financial layer.
